title: Star Wars: The Phantom Menace Review (Part 1 of 7)
summary: The first of seven parts of RedLetterMedia's long review of Star Wars: The Phantom Menace. It argues that the film's central flaw is its characters and the lack of audience connection.
why: HN commenters recommend it as sharp film criticism and a lesson in filmmaking, and cite it when arguing the prequels failed on basics.

quote.text: thanks to them I have learned a lot about movies, actors, directors and movie making in general.
